description: This file defines the `TaskSearchCriteria` class, which extends `SearchCriteria` and provides methods to add various search filters related to tasks, such as project, status, assignee, priority, keywords, user, and project archival status. It appears to be part of a search or filtering subsystem within a project management or task tracking application.

classes.name: TaskSearchCriteria
classes.description: A class that encapsulates search criteria specific to tasks, allowing filtering by project, status, template status, assignee, priority, keywords, user, and archived status.

methods.name: addProjectCriterion
methods.description: Adds a filter for tasks belonging to a specific project identified by its ID.

methods.name: addStatusCriterion
methods.description: Adds a filter for tasks with a specific status.

methods.name: addProjectTemplateCriterion
methods.description: Adds a filter based on whether the project is a template.

methods.name: addProjectIsNotTemplateCriterion
methods.description: Adds a filter to exclude project templates, filtering for non-template projects.

methods.name: addAssigneeCriterion
methods.description: Filters tasks assigned to a specific user by their UID.

methods.name: addKeywordsCriterion
methods.description: Filters tasks where summary or description contain specific keywords.

methods.name: addUserCriterion
methods.description: Filters tasks visible to a specific user, considering project visibility and user permissions.

methods.name: addProjectArchivedCriterion
methods.description: Filters tasks based on whether the project is archived or not.
